- **Telecom Customer Churn Predictor**: Production-ready predictive classifier utilizing Random Forest and XGBoost with **89.2% ROC-AUC score**, featuring SHAP feature explainability.
- **Interactive High-Performance Developer Portfolio**: Responsive, ultra-fast web application with sub-second FCP, structured Schema.org graphs, and Lighthouse performance compliance.
